title: Cranial nerves and skull-base context in the native MIDA model
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Explore every delivered cranial-nerve class and relevant skull, dura, vascular and CSF context while distinguishing model evidence from unavailable original MRI.

scenes.title: Olfactory and optic source anatomy
scenes.prompt: Locate the olfactory and optic source labels, optic chiasm and optic tract. Compare their relations to the pituitary and sphenoidal sinus air without inferring an unlabelled canal boundary.
scenes.note: The delivered MIDA model represents categorical voxel labels. Surfaces follow the unchanged original label sampling. Each source nerve class retains its complete delivered extent, which may span both sides or include extracranial and cervical portions. Cerebral gray matter, white matter and skull classes provide categorical-section context and translucent 3D context. Anatomical coverage follows the listed source tissue classes.
